Id.description: The sensor id sent in the MCTP VDM request that reads the sensor. 255 is not an id: the temperature and power requests take it to ask for every sensor at once.

Name.description: Name of the sensor, published on D-Bus as <device>_<Name>, where <device> is the name the device is given on D-Bus.

NvidiaMctpVdmGpu.description: An Nvidia GPU that implements an MCTP VDM protocol to provide sensor readings - implemented in dbus-sensors

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

PollRate.description: Poll the device at this rate, specified in milliseconds, to fetch sensors

NvidiaMctpVdmSma.description: An Nvidia SMA that implements an MCTP VDM protocol to provide sensor readings - implemented in dbus-sensors

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

PollRate.description: Poll the device at this rate, specified in milliseconds, to fetch sensors

PowerSensors.description: The power sensors to read from the device, one sensor per entry.

TemperatureSensors.description: The temperature sensors to read from the device, one sensor per entry.

VoltageSensors.description: The voltage sensors to read from the device, one sensor per entry.

NvidiaMctpVdmCx.description: An Nvidia ConnectX device that implements an MCTP VDM protocol to provide sensor readings - implemented in dbus-sensors

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

PollRate.description: Poll the device at this rate, specified in milliseconds, to fetch sensors

PortCount.description: The number of network ports on the device
